test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

There was __a huge fire for celebration__ on the occasion of Diwali.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bonfire"** means a large fire built outdoors, typically for celebration or warmth. (आग का बड़ा ढेर)

 
 
• **Example:** The villagers gathered around the **bonfire** to celebrate the festival.
 
 
 
• **"Firecracker"** refers to a small explosive device used primarily for celebration, creating noise, light, and smoke. (पटाखा)
 
 
• **Example:** Children enjoy lighting** firecrackers** during Diwali.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct word for a large fire for celebration is **"Bonfire"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lohri** (लोहड़ी): A Punjabi festival celebrated in January, involving singing and dancing around a bonfire.

 
 
• **Example:** **Lohri **is celebrated with great enthusiasm in Punjab.
 
 
 
• **Flash** (चमक): A sudden burst of light.
 
 
• **Example:** There was a sudden **flash** of lightning during the storm.
 
 
 
• **Firecracker** (पटाखा): A small explosive device used for celebrations.
 
 
• **Example:** Children enjoy lighting** firecrackers** during Diwali.
